name: How much does it cost to build an ADU in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an ADU in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building an ADU in Los Angeles varies significantly based on size, design complexity, materials, and site conditions. A basic detached ADU can range from $150,000 to $350,000 or more. Factors like foundation work, utility hookups, interior finishes, and architectural plans all influence the final price. It's best to consult with a contractor for a detailed estimate based on your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU costs in Los Angeles vary widely, typically from $150,000 to $350,000+, depending on size, design, and materials. Consult a contractor for an accurate estimate.
